Risk: Remote APK build system not available
Mitigation: Set up reproducible CI/remote Godot SDK build; run proof APK
Required_Evidence: Actual APK, logs, digest, device install

Mitigation: Verify targetSdk 36 in built manifest; validate AAB
Required_Evidence: Verified Android manifest and Play-ready export

Risk: Art quality drift from intended style
Mitigation: Approve art bible, screen references, in-engine screenshot reviews

Risk: Game concept lacks validated player interest
Mitigation: Competitor research and external first-time playtest
Small first release, formal backlog change control, gate approvals
Required_Evidence: GDD v1 scope and approved changes

Risk: Third-party asset copyright or license violations
Play account cost or testing prerequisite unknown
Mitigation: Check account eligibility and realistic test recruitment before launch
Required_Evidence: Verified account state and launch checklist

Risk: Poor offline save or device lifecycle handling
Mitigation: Specify lifecycle in GDD; automated and device tests

Risk: Genre-scale revenue misread as achievable individual-game income
Mitigation: Separate IAP vs ad and markets; no revenue forecasts without audience and retention evidence
Required_Evidence: Market definition plus actual cohort unit economics

Risk: Candidate title or mechanic resembles existing IP
Mitigation: Direct competitor and trademark screening before concept lock; build original assets
Required_Evidence: Competitor comparison and legal risk review

Risk: Story-driven candidate needs more writing and localization than budget
Mitigation: Scope case/episode count; test one representative vignette and translation workflow
Required_Evidence: Content production pilot and language plan

Risk: Exact working-title and premise collision in C01/C02/C04/C06
Mitigation: Retire exact names; redesign duplicated mechanics; trademark/search screening
Required_Evidence: Collision audit completed and cleared alternate names only after concept validated

Risk: Film tycoon core feature set already crowded in 2026
Mitigation: Test a new primary player verb rather than generic film release loop
Required_Evidence: Mechanic experiment compared with Movie Tycoon and Silver Screen Story

Risk: Public store signals and selected reviews overinterpreted as conversion potential
Mitigation: Mark observations vs hypotheses; recruit actual testers; refrain from forecasts
Required_Evidence: Review coding and real player data

Risk: Paper puzzle appears unique only because rule omitted edge cases
Mitigation: Enumerate every binary configuration and publish exact semantics; validate instructions with humans

Risk: Film player ratings conflated with audience interpretation
Mitigation: Separate maker intent from a blind viewer judgment; do not score individual solutions as objectively correct

Risk: Real participants not yet recruited or their data collected
Mitigation: Do not imply paper artifacts equal player validation; user can recruit consented participants

Risk: Concept lab examples trivial or too text-heavy on a mobile screen
Mitigation: Use both introductory and extended worksheets and test legibility at common Android sizes
